active_source_inventory.source_line_text: Cluster algebras are a well-loved object of study in algebraic combinatorics because of their deep connection to a myriad of mathematical fields. Many mathematicians are interested in finding combinatorial models for the generators of these algebras, which are otherwise only recursively defined. This paper addresses that question for certain cluster algebras coming from the Grassmannian, which is denoted $\Gr(k,n)$ and refers to the set of $k$-dimensional subspaces of $\mathbb{C}^n$.
